question: Cabinet approves Minimum Support Prices (MSP) for Kharif Crops for Marketing Season 2025-26. Which crop received the highest absolute increase in MSP?
solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Nigerseed**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Cabinet approves Minimum Support Prices (MSP) for Kharif Crops for Marketing Season 2025-26.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The **Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs**, chaired by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, has approved an **increase in Minimum Support Prices (MSP)** for **14 Kharif crops**.

 
 
• 
 
This MSP hike is for the **Marketing Season 2025–26**.

 
 
• 
 
The aim is to ensure **remunerative prices** for farmers' produce.

 
 
• 
 
The **highest absolute MSP increase** is for **nigerseed** — **₹820 per quintal**.

 
 
• 
 
This is followed by:

 
 
• 
 
**Ragi** – ₹596 per quintal

 
 
• 
 
**Cotton** – ₹589 per quintal

 
 
• 
 
**Sesamum** – ₹579 per quintal
